notes.title: Sneak to survive an even deadlier State

items.text: Hello Outlaws!

Update 1.7 is now live and introduces our new free PvE mode: State Heist! We are excited for you to try this new mode which focuses on stealth, and methodical cooperation. Your team of up to four players is pitted against a far more dangerous and responsive State. With limitations on respawning and a dangerous Sherif, State heist creates a completely new dynamic - one that will require a more careful and sneaky approach for success! Watch the State Heist Update Trailer for a taste of what awaits in-game!

notes.title: Execute the perfect State Heist to get the Shadowlord costumes in a new event!

items.text: To celebrate the State Heist launch, we are kicking off the Survive the State event. Players who successfully complete a State Heist without dying will receive the new Shadow Lords costume for the character they were playing. A worthy challenge for fearless Outlaws! The rewards will be unlocked when the event ends on August 2nd.

You can look forward to even more free content over the course of this year! Season 1: Samhain is just around the corner, bringing a free, game-changing new outlaw: Eidaa. We will also include a full rework of the winch system, tons of cosmetics, community events, and much more.

Team up with up to three friendly Outlaws and infiltrate the State’s strongholds to steal their treasure! In this new cooperative game mode you will fight as one against tougher guards, with limited resources and the fearsome Sheriff tracking your every move. Silent infiltration will be your best weapon to succeed in this deadly new experience.

Hey everyone!

Update 1.6 is now live and this is the most significant update in terms of gameplay changes since launch! For this update, We've mainly been looking at character balance changes and improvements to melee combat. The main headline is that Marianne was tuned down based on your feedback.
We want to start by thanking you for all your comments on combat and character balance. They have driven the updates in this patch and helped us prioritize the changes.

For balance, we've been looking at all the characters, some feel too powerful in certain areas while some feel too underwhelming. That is why we have substantial changes for every character. Of course, we are looking forward to your feedback on these changes.
We also improved the general feeling of combat, by adjusting hit detection for the melee characters’ heavy attacks and by improving the behavior of the melee helper (lock-on system).
We are also introducing our first community event with a double XP weekend!

Looking further afield, we have of course the PvE mode to look forward to in July (you can learn more in our Dev Vlog #3 below), and an exciting rework of the winch mechanic, which we will talk about later. We will continue paying close attention to to the following topics:
Character balance (their attacks, evading, abilities, perks...)
AI combat improvements (targeting, prioritization...)
Quality of life improvements (accessibility, UI)
As always, thank you for your support and keep the feedback coming!
Melee targeting improvements, melee attacks without Lock-On are now easier to hit, target prioritization is improved (especially for sprinting attacks and Tooke's heavy attack)
Melee attacks on crouched enemies should now hit more consistently.
Tree branches and leaves collisions on Outpost fixed so they don't block arrows/bolts
A new option called "Assassination Camera" allows players to disable the takedown mini-cutscenes
Temporary community events and rewards are now displayed in the game
Aiming now requires stamina and halts stamina regeneration.

Roving Rogue reworked: Previously with the perk Marianne would pick up 2 bolts from a single bolt in the environment, with her bolts having a 25% chance to break on impact. Now with the perk Marianne picks up 1 bolt from a single bolt in the environment, but her bolts no longer break on impact
Increased the delay between the moment Marianne aims and is able to fire, effectively removing Quick Shots.
Smoke Bomb now affects AI in a smaller radius.
Surging Smash no longer kills Tooke in a single hit.
Surging Smash no longer removes Stamina for performing Light Attacks while sprinting.
John is now able to use Wrath to cancel assassination attempts on his life.
John is now unable to be assassinated when under the effects of Wrath. He still remains vulnerable to the Sheriff.
John’s sprint attack is now less generous in terms of hit detection.
Heavy Attack no longer collides with friendly characters
Healing Gas no longer affects AI negatively.

Poison Gas no longer hides the player from the Sheriff; other guards are still affected.

Hello Outlaws,

Patch 1.4 is now available to download. We look forward to your feedback, and to releasing everything else we have in store for you! You can discover more details about that in last week's Developer Vlog.
Balancing
Assassinations can now be interrupted if damage to assassin exceeds a certain threshold (read more here) TLDR: most basic attacks interrupt it now.
Combat
Players can now exit stagger/stun more consistently through dodging/blocking, to reduce situations where players would get stunlocked
Matchmaking
Players on EGS can now invite players on Steam to their group.

After the end of a match, players are moved back to the hideout, but remain in their squads. This should reduce matchmaking times because before, players were leaving the automatic queue in order to return to the hideout, which had a negative impact on queue times.

Greetings Outlaws,

Patch 1.3 is live! We've just released a new update with some significant fixes and improvements. Along with a number of bug fixes (such as the black screen on match start), controller sensitivity has been raised, and we've continued making improvements to matchmaking. This is our first patch of this size, and it's the first of many. Among other things, we're now concentrating on assassinations, further matchmaking improvements, and UI/feedback tweaks.
Thank you all for your feedback! Keep it up, because we're listening! Please don't hesitate to let us know if you run into any bugs in our technical support section.

Hello everyone!
Yesterday we updated you on what topics we’re focusing on addressing, to give you a better understanding of where we’re at with updates.
We won’t repeat all the points here, so please feel free to check it out.

Since launch, we’ve released several hotfixes to resolve unexpected technical issues. Today, we’re releasing our first update on Steam, fixing two important issues. It’s thanks to your reports that we can move fast with fixes and updates like these, so please keep them coming!

Our current priority is to make sure everyone’s experience is stable and sorting out any stand-out technical issues, as well as ensuring everyone can get into games quickly. After that comes improvements on topics we’ve seen a lot of feedback for, and finally, new content and balancing.
More updates are coming soon - with more fixes, improvements, content, and balancing for all platforms - we’ll update you on that as soon as we can.
Matchmaking improvements. We fixed a couple of bugs which were increasing the time it took to get into a game, or caused the queue to fail.
Arrow keys can now be used for movement. Before, camera movement was bound to the arrow keys as well. Time to steal some treasure, left-handed players!
